The structure of Mg4Fe2Sb2O12 (Mg2FeSbO6) adopts the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Sb each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Mg centers have four O neighbors. The FeO6 and SbO6 octahedra share corners, and edge-sharing is observed between FeO6 octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
